title: Adaptive Weight Sharing NAS Experiment
objective: Compare adaptive weight sharing against uniform weight sharing in neural architecture search, measuring both search efficiency and final architecture quality.
baseline_description: Uniform weight sharing supernet trained with standard one-shot NAS on CIFAR-10. Uses the same supernet architecture and training schedule as the proposed method.
method_description: 1. Build a supernet with weight-sharing cells. 2. Implement adaptive weight allocation based on architecture similarity scores. 3. Train for 200 epochs on CIFAR-10. 4. Search for top architectures using evolutionary search. 5. Retrain top-3 architectures standalone. 6. Compare against uniform weight sharing baseline.

controls.name: no_sharing
controls.description: Independent training of each architecture (upper bound)

metrics.name: top1_accuracy
metrics.description: Top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 test set

metrics.name: search_gpu_hours
metrics.description: Total GPU hours for architecture search

metrics.name: rank_correlation
metrics.description: Spearman correlation between supernet and standalone rankings

expected_outputs.description: Accuracy comparison table (adaptive vs uniform vs no sharing)
Search efficiency comparison (GPU hours, architectures evaluated)
